name: Allen
source:
He looks like an ordinary university student. Tall, slim and handsome, he is also smart - top of his class and popular on campus. There's a sense that his good looks let him get away with a degree of arrogance and lack of restraint, however, Allen has a secret identity. He is actually an elite assassin, trained from a young age as a professional killer.

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
